resolution: Two follow-ups from driving the lab. (1) 'Follow behind it but let my camera movements peek and always return to center — otherwise I'm zip-zip-zipping around': replaced the free user-orbit with a GTA-style auto-centering chase cam. Base orbit yaw now trails behind the car's heading (yaw = heading*RAD); mouse drag adds only a PEEK offset (offsetRef) that eases back to zero each frame via RECENTER_RATE, so you can look around but always settle behind the car. Scroll still dollies distance; reset snaps the peek back. (2) 'No drag on turning, I just go full-speed donuts': the model scrubbed lateral velocity but never bled FORWARD speed in a turn, so you could hold top speed around any radius. Added corneringDrag to GAME_DRIVING — forward speed bleeds proportional to steer fraction (|steer|/maxSteer), always toward zero, never reversing the car — and exposed it as a 'cornering' knob (default 0.55). Verified: bundles clean with full @game+runtime resolution, no stale refs.
